0022600025.text: The Atlanta Hawks (4-4, second in the Southeast, 0.5 games back, seventh in the East, on a one-game win streak) host the Washington Wizards (4-3, first in the Southeast, sixth in the East, on a two-game win streak) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Asa Newell is day-to-day with a toe injury and is a game-time decision, while Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The Hawks won the teams' last meeting 126-96 in Atlanta on February 26 and took the 2025-26 season series 3-1, and the two teams have not yet played each other in the 2026-27 season.
